title: The Charcoal Burner's Guest
rumor: The Charcoal Burner's Guest. An old story tells of a charcoal burner who offered shelter to a strange traveler during a terrible winter. In gratitude, the visitor showed him a hidden place where the forest floor was scattered with silver coins. The burner became wealthy but refused to reveal the location. His abandoned charcoal kiln supposedly still stands beside the trail.
first_lead: Descendants of the burner's neighbors remember the approximate location of his former camp.
